protocol: Original complete 12-cell identical-main controls, then all 12 candidate/main pairs only if controls pass, then all 12 enabled/main pairs only if candidate gate passes.
order: reverse the adjacent pair on odd cell indices
client_mask: next two allowed CPUs; disjoint and equal budget

prior_evidence: Retain all failed old-candidate, stage, routing and earlier calibration observations; this campaign does not erase them.
